Review the provided proposal against the repository architecture and engineering practices. Identify assumptions, affected contracts, alternatives, failure modes, migration and rollback needs, security and privacy risks, observability needs, and missing evidence. Return prioritized findings first, then open questions, then a concise recommendation. Be specific and distinguish facts from assumptions.
